en.headline: Education Bureau says TSA student performance remains steady
en.dek: Primary 3 and Secondary 3 results in Chinese, English and Mathematics were generally stable this year and aligned with previous assessments, the bureau said after receiving the HKEAA report.
body: The Education Bureau said on Thursday it had received the 2026 Territory-wide System Assessment report from the Hong Kong Examinations and Assessment Authority.

The bureau said the performance of Primary 3 and Secondary 3 students in Chinese Language, English Language and Mathematics remained generally steady and was broadly similar to the previous assessment. Reports indicated that Primary 3 English attainment reached 86.3 per cent, up 3.1 percentage points, while Chinese stood at 81.7 per cent and Mathematics at 84.7 per cent.

For Secondary 3, Chinese attainment was 77.1 per cent, English 69.2 per cent and Mathematics 78.3 per cent. The bureau said schools widely use the data together with internal assessments to refine curriculum and teaching under the Assessment for Learning approach. The authority will distribute school-level data, and the bureau plans thematic seminars next month.

zh.headline: 教育局：系統評估學生中英數表現保持平穩
zh.dek: 考評局提交的2026年全港性系統評估報告顯示，小三及中三學生在中、英、數科表現大致平穩，與上次結果相若。
body: 教育局周四表示，已收到香港考試及評核局提交的2026年全港性系統評估報告。
局方指出，今年參與評估的小三和中三學生在中文、英文及數學三個主要科目的表現保持平穩，與上次系統評估結果大致相若。報告顯示小三英文科達標率為86.3%，按年升3.1個百分點；中文為81.7%，數學為84.7%。
中三方面，中文科達標率為77.1%，英文69.2%，數學78.3%。教育局指學界普遍應用評估報告數據，結合校內評估以優化課程及教學，發揮促進學習的功能。考評局稍後會向學校發放層面數據，局方下月將舉行專題講座。
